candlestick-patterns-from-zero.title: Candlestick Patterns From Zero
candlestick-patterns-from-zero.subtitle: A Visual Trading Course for Beginners
candlestick-patterns-from-zero.seo_description: A 100-page visual beginner course on candlestick anatomy, OHLC, candle psychology, reversal and continuation patterns, confirmation, context, risk, entries, stops and targets.
candlestick-patterns-from-zero.summary: Candlestick Patterns From Zero is a 100-page visual course that teaches candlestick reading from basic OHLC anatomy through pattern recognition, market context, confirmation and risk-aware execution. The book treats candle patterns as clues rather than guarantees: readers learn to interpret bodies and wicks, bullish and bearish candles, doji structures, hammers, shooting stars, engulfing patterns, harami patterns, morning and evening stars, multi-candle formations and gaps while checking trend, support and resistance, volume, volatility and higher-level context. Later lessons connect recognition to practical decision rules for entry triggers, stop-loss placement, targets, risk-reward, invalidation and confirmation.
learning: Read open, high, low and close structure and interpret candle bodies and wicks.
Recognize common bullish, bearish and neutral candlestick formations without treating them as automatic signals.
Judge patterns in relation to trend, support and resistance, volume, volatility and market location.
Wait for confirmation and define an entry trigger instead of entering solely because a pattern appears.
Place stops beyond logical invalidation points and map targets from chart structure.
Evaluate risk-reward and know when a technically attractive pattern is still a poor trade.
Use a confirmation ladder and reliability checklist to turn pattern literacy into a repeatable process.
candlestick-patterns-from-zero.target_audience: For beginner and early-intermediate traders who want a highly visual introduction to candlestick reading, pattern context, confirmation and risk-aware execution.

ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers.title: AI Prompts for E-Commerce Sellers
ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers.subtitle: A Copy-and-Adapt Prompt Library for Product Research, Listings, Ads, Customer Messages, Conversion & Store Operations
ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers.seo_description: A practical 278-prompt e-commerce AI library for product research, listings, SEO, ads, customer messaging, conversion, retention, catalog operations, analytics and scalable workflows.
ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers.summary: AI Prompts for E-Commerce Sellers treats generative AI as a decision-support layer for a store rather than merely a copywriter. Its 278 prompts connect verified evidence, constraints, structured outputs and human review to store goals, customer insight, product research, catalog positioning, listings, search intent, product pages, conversion, offers, advertising, lifecycle messaging, support, social proof, cart recovery, retention, merchandising, localization, analytics and reusable master workflows.
learning: Turn store goals, constraints and available data into reusable AI briefs.
Separate facts, assumptions, estimates and open questions before AI output is used.
Analyze customers, demand and product opportunities without fabricating evidence.
Build listings, product pages, search-aligned content and conversion briefs from verified facts.
Create structured workflows for ads, lifecycle messaging, support, retention and catalog operations.
Design localization, analytics and A/B testing workflows with explicit human review points.
Maintain reusable prompts with owners, variables, versioning and review triggers.
ai-prompts-for-e-commerce-sellers.target_audience: For store owners, marketplace sellers, e-commerce teams, product and merchandising managers, marketers and entrepreneurs who want AI integrated into daily store operations with evidence and human review.

footprint-charts.title: Footprint Charts
footprint-charts.subtitle: Reading Buyers and Sellers Inside the Candle
footprint-charts.seo_description: A practical guide to footprint charts, bid × ask, delta, imbalances, absorption, trapped traders, POC, VWAP, market structure, execution, risk and backtesting.
footprint-charts.summary: Footprint Charts expands the information hidden inside a candlestick into executed volume at price, then places that detail inside a disciplined Context → Location → Order Flow → Trigger → Risk hierarchy. It covers data-source limitations, bid × ask, delta, imbalances, absorption, exhaustion, trapped traders, delta divergence, candle POC, Volume Profile, VWAP, market structure, liquidity, volatility, reversals, breakouts, retests, invalidation, slippage, replay and backtesting without treating footprint detail as certainty.
learning: Understand what footprint charts add to OHLC candles and what they still cannot reveal.
Interpret aggressive execution, bid × ask, delta and imbalances without inventing trader motives.
Recognize absorption, exhaustion, trapped traders and effort-versus-result divergence.
Combine footprint evidence with Volume Profile, VWAP, market structure, liquidity and regime context.
Build triggers, invalidation, stops, targets and no-trade rules around order-flow evidence.
Account for feed, venue, platform, slippage and execution differences.
Use replay and backtesting to test interpretations rather than memorizing ideal screenshots.
footprint-charts.target_audience: For discretionary futures, crypto, forex and short-term traders who understand basic candlesticks and want a rigorous introduction to footprint and order-flow analysis.

ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots.title: AI Trading Agents & AI Trading Bots
ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots.subtitle: Building Smarter Trading Workflows
ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots.seo_description: A practical engineering guide to AI trading agents and bots covering data pipelines, decision engines, risk, execution, testing, production architecture, security, autonomy, five end-to-end builds and failure discipline.
ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots.summary: AI Trading Agents & AI Trading Bots treats an AI trading system as a governed workflow rather than a model attached directly to execution. It follows the path from evidence and market state through models, policy, abstention and independent risk to order-state reconciliation, portfolio constraints, testing, production architecture, security, graded autonomy and five end-to-end builds. The final sections study failure chains, backtest overfitting, uncertainty and controlled deployment, supported by implementation templates, checklists and incident dossiers.
learning: Separate model proposals from permission and economic authority.
Build evidence-preserving data, context and memory pipelines.
Combine probabilistic models with deterministic policy, abstention and independent risk controls.
Design execution workflows that reconcile external state after partial fills, timeouts and restarts.
Validate systems through chronology-preserving backtests, walk-forward testing, shadow mode and staged deployment.
Build production services with observability, least privilege, security boundaries and recovery.
Use graded, reversible autonomy and analyze failure chains before expanding authority.
Apply five reference architectures for research, setup detection, risk-controlled execution, multi-agent coordination and copilots.
ai-trading-agents-and-ai-trading-bots.target_audience: For active traders, developers, AI practitioners, quant-minded readers and technical investors who want to understand or build inspectable AI trading workflows without surrendering risk discipline.

cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.title: Cuando el dinero no alcanza
cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.subtitle: Cómo cambiar los gastos de alimentación, vivienda, salud, transporte y vida cotidiana en épocas de presión económica sin dañar lo que de verdad importa
cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.seo_description: Una guía práctica para reorganizar alimentación, vivienda, salud, transporte y vida cotidiana bajo presión económica sin destruir la salud, la seguridad, la familia, el futuro ni la dignidad.
cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.summary: Cuando el dinero no alcanza propone un método de decisión para cuando los ingresos ya no cubren el coste real de una vida razonable. Distingue entre ahorrar, sustituir y cambiar el modelo de vida; ordena los gastos por la función que cumplen; protege salud, seguridad, capacidad de trabajar, futuro y dignidad; y aplica esa lógica a comida, vivienda, transporte, medicación, educación, familia, deuda, ahorros y recuperación financiera. Su objetivo no es construir la vida más barata posible, sino la vida sostenible de menor coste que cause el menor daño a lo que resulta difícil reconstruir.
key_topics: Ahorro, sustitución y cambio de modelo
learning: Distinguir pequeños recortes de un déficit estructural.
Separar la necesidad de la forma concreta de pagarla.
Clasificar gastos por importancia y daño potencial.
Comparar el ahorro visible con costes ocultos en salud, tiempo, seguridad y futuro.
Calcular costes reales de comida, vivienda, transporte y pagos automáticos.
Definir mejor el uso de ahorros, deuda y fondo de emergencia.
Tomar decisiones familiares compartidas sin convertir el presupuesto en una búsqueda de culpables.
Evitar reconstruir automáticamente todos los gastos antiguos cuando mejoren los ingresos.
cuando-el-dinero-no-alcanza.target_audience: Para lectores generales que atraviesan presión económica y necesitan reorganizar gastos esenciales y cotidianos sin sacrificar innecesariamente salud, seguridad, relaciones, futuro o dignidad.

para-yetmediginde.title: Para Yetmediğinde
para-yetmediginde.subtitle: Ekonomik baskı dönemlerinde gıda, barınma, sağlık, ulaşım ve günlük yaşam giderlerini, hayatın önemli parçalarına zarar vermeden nasıl değiştirebiliriz
para-yetmediginde.seo_description: Ekonomik baskı dönemlerinde gıda, barınma, sağlık, ulaşım ve günlük yaşam giderlerini; sağlık, güvenlik, aile, gelecek ve özsaygıya mümkün olduğunca az zarar vererek yeniden düzenleme rehberi.
para-yetmediginde.summary: Para Yetmediğinde, gelirin artık makul bir hayatın gerçek maliyetini karşılamadığı dönemler için karar verme yöntemi sunar. Tasarruf, ikame ve model değişikliğini birbirinden ayırır; giderleri işlevine göre önceliklendirir; sağlık, güvenlik, çalışma kapasitesi, gelecek ve onur tabanını korur; bu yaklaşımı gıda, konut, ulaşım, ilaç, eğitim, aile, borç, birikim ve mali toparlanmaya uygular. Amaç en ucuz hayatı değil, önemli olanı mümkün olduğunca koruyan en düşük maliyetli sürdürülebilir hayatı kurmaktır.
learning: Küçük tasarruf sorununu yapısal bütçe açığından ayırmak.
İhtiyacı onu karşılama biçiminden ayırmak.
Giderleri önem ve olası zarara göre sınıflandırmak.
Görünür tasarrufu sağlık, zaman, güvenlik ve gelecek üzerindeki gizli maliyetle birlikte değerlendirmek.
Yemek, konut, ulaşım ve otomatik ödemelerin gerçek maliyetini hesaplamak.
Birikim, borç ve acil durum fonu için daha açık kurallar geliştirmek.
Aile içi bütçe kararlarını suçlama yerine ortak bilgiyle yürütmek.
Gelir artınca eski tüm giderleri otomatik olarak geri getirmemek.
para-yetmediginde.target_audience: Ekonomik baskı altında gıda, barınma, ulaşım, sağlık, eğitim, borç ve günlük tüketim kararlarını yeniden düzenlemek isteyen genel okur için.
